results.name: r1
results.command: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('README.md').read(); p=t.split('**Starting a new repository?**',1)[1].split('##',1)[0]; sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'OpenCode', p) else 1)"

results.name: r2
results.command: bash -c 'set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[opencode]" /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/demo; python3 -c "import yaml,sys; a=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert a[\"targets\"]==[\"opencode\"], a; assert a[\"dependencies\"][\"apm\"][0][\"ref\"]==\"v0.5.1\", a" $d/demo/apm.yml; grep -q "kmctl_ref := \"v0.5.1\"" $d/demo/justfile; grep -q "v0.5.1" $d/demo/.github/workflows/ci.yml; rm -rf $d'

results.name: r3
results.command: bash -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); out=$(uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[opencode]" --data kmctl_ref=v0.5.0 /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/a 2>&1) && exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -q v0.5.1 || exit 1; uvx copier copy -q --vcs-ref HEAD --defaults --data project_name=demo --data codeowners=@o --data "harnesses=[claude]" --data kmctl_ref=v0.5.0 /home/vscode/kmctl-starter $d/b; rc=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $rc'
